strings.Option.remove-desktop-netfx.Description: Remove desktop .NET payloads and native-image caches. Managed applications may stop working.

strings.Option.remove-ime-files.Description: Remove Asian-language input-method payloads. Keep this group unchecked if you need those input methods.

strings.Option.remove-print-drivers.Description: Remove matching printer/scanner driver-store folders. Storage, USB, display and network drivers are not selected.

strings.Option.remove-extra-media.Description: Remove bundled wallpapers, system sounds, help files and optional cursor artwork.

strings.Text.CoreRemovesUpdateAndRecoverySupport: Core removes update and recovery support.
strings.Text.CoreDeletesComponentFilesAndWinREAn: Core deletes component files and WinRE, and disables Windows Update and Defender. Include updates, languages and features before pruning; you cannot add them afterward. Test the image in a VM.
strings.Text.TheseAreThePresetSConfiguredActions: These are the preset's configured actions, not components confirmed present in this image. Availability depends on the Windows version and edition. Missing items are skipped and recorded in the build log.
strings.Text.CoreAlsoIrreversiblyPrunesComponent: Core also irreversibly prunes component files, removes the recovery environment, and disables Windows Update and Microsoft Defender. Updates selected in Build settings are integrated before pruning; future servicing is not supported.
strings.Text.CheckedGroupsAreRemovedOrDisabledUn: Checked groups are removed or disabled. Unchecked groups are kept. For individual items, use the component list below.
strings.Text.ListTheImageSAppsPackagesFeaturesSe: List the image's apps, packages, features, services and component files, including protected items. Removing a service deletes its registry entry, not shared executables. Protected packages may refuse removal.
strings.Text.SaveEveryLoadedComponentToALocalTex: Save every loaded component to a local text file, including names, identifiers and kinds. Filters and selections do not limit the export. Nothing is uploaded.
strings.Text.RemovingProtectedOrBootCriticalItem: Removing protected or boot-critical items can create an unbootable or insecure image. Direct payload removal bypasses servicing. No dependency solver or boot guarantee is provided.
strings.Text.IAcceptTheRiskOfAnUnbootableUnservi: I accept the risk of an unbootable, unserviceable or insecure custom image.
strings.Text.IndividualRemovalsAddToTheSelectedG: Individual removals add to the selected groups. To keep a component, leave both its group and its individual entry unchecked.
strings.Text.ChooseWhereToBuildAndHowToCompressY: Choose where to build and how to compress your image.
strings.Text.WorkspaceNTFSTwiceISOSize: Workspace (NTFS, free space: twice the ISO size)
strings.Text.AddLocalMsuOrCabPackagesInTheOrder: Add local .msu or .cab packages in the order required by Microsoft. Add checkpoint cumulative updates and other prerequisites yourself, then the target update. No folders are scanned and no updates are downloaded. Source packages are not changed.
strings.Text.PackagesAreIntegratedBeforeRemovals: Packages are integrated before removals, cleanup and .NET 3.5. Some updates remain pending until Windows first boots; the report distinguishes DISM results from verified first-boot installation. Core pruning is refused while servicing is pending.
strings.Text.WindowsUpdatePackagesInIntegrationO: Windows update packages in integration order
strings.Text.BatchFeatureAndCapabilityRemovalsAn: Batch feature and capability removals and reduce log overhead. Core and Fast WIM builds use a faster working image. Uses more CPU and temporary space; final compression stays as selected.
strings.Text.RemoveDownloadedUpdateCachesArchive: Remove downloaded update caches, archived servicing logs, temporary files and crash reports. Pending servicing data, drivers and installers are kept.
strings.Text.LeaveSourcesSxsOutOfTheISOYouCan: Leave sources\sxs out of the ISO. You can still include .NET 3.5 now; enabling it later requires separate matching media or Windows Update. Core cannot add it later.
strings.Text.InstallWindowsUsingCompressedSystem: Install Windows using compressed system files to reduce disk usage.
strings.Text.IncludeSupportForOlderAppsRequiredS: Include support for older apps. Required source files must be present in the ISO.
strings.Text.PreferLocalSignInDuringSetupSomeNew: Prefer local sign-in during setup. Some newer builds may still request a Microsoft account.
strings.Text.RetainTheModifiedInstallationMediaA: Retain the modified installation media after the ISO is saved. Uses more disk space.
strings.Text.ImageAndISOToolsArePreparedAutomati: Image and ISO tools are prepared automatically.
strings.Text.CheckYourImageRemovalSetAndOutputBe: Check your image, removal set and output before building.
strings.Text.SomePoliciesApplyOnlyToParticularEd: Some policies apply only to particular editions or builds. Feature updates can reinstall apps. Local-account and hardware bypasses are best effort. Test the resulting ISO before relying on it.
strings.Text.TheSelectedEditionWillBeCopiedModif: The selected edition will be copied, modified, compressed and saved as a bootable ISO.
strings.Text.ToStopUseCancelSafelyAtTheTopRight: To stop, use Cancel safely at the top right. It stops at the next safe point. Your source is never changed; working files, saved progress and logs are kept.

strings.Text.Joined658: Select only job.json from the interrupted tiny11 job. This discards that job's mounted working copy and removes its staged media. Its logs, recipe, report and your source ISO are kept. A job whose image was already committed has saved progress and is never discarded here; use Resume build for it. Active builds cannot be recovered.
strings.Image.ServerUnsupported: Windows Server images are not supported.
strings.Preset.EdgePolicyWithFileRemoval: Suppress first-run, sidebar and recommendations. This preset also removes Edge and WebView2 files through its separate file-removal group.
